dz: 教皇斯蒂芬 我接任教宗路西斯一世,成为天主教会第23任教宗,并立即采取反对诺瓦蒂亚主义的立场.
de: Pope Stephen I succeeds Pope Lucius I, becoming the 23rd pope of the Catholic Church, and immediately takes a stand against Novatianism.
